name: fix_csharp_for_loop_closure_capture
description: Fixes a for-loop that captures the same loop variable in every closure, so all thunks return the final value
prompts: Callbacks.Build(int count) in Callbacks.cs should return a list of `count` thunks where the i-th thunk returns i (so Build(3) yields thunks returning 0, 1, 2). It's broken: the `for` loop closes over the single loop variable i, so every thunk captures the SAME variable and they all return the final value of i (count). Fix Build so each thunk captures its own iteration value (capture a per-iteration local, or use foreach over a range) and returns the correct index. Keep the class name and the Build(int) signature.

setup_files.app.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- tests/ has its own project; without this the SDK's default glob
         compiles tests/*.cs into the app itself, where xunit isn't referenced -->
    <Compile Remove="tests/**" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
